meta.description: Registry for bounded nonlocal transport-closure conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

transport_closure_entries.name: Nonlocal Transport Closure
transport_closure_entries.purpose: Represent bounded admissibility-preserving transport closure across nonlocal CSI-linked continuation structures.

transport_closure_conditions.name: transport_flux_remains_finite
transport_closure_conditions.description: Measurement of transported continuation events does not diverge per recursive step.

transport_closure_conditions.name: nonlocal_admissibility_preserved
transport_closure_conditions.description: Transport across non-adjacent process loci must satisfy nonlocal window constraints.

transport_closure_conditions.name: recursive_transport_updates_remain_bounded
transport_closure_conditions.description: Composition of transport operators over multiple steps remains within a finite or conditionally stable neighborhood.

transport_closure_conditions.name: CSI_linkage_remains_defined
transport_closure_conditions.description: Interaction domains (CSI) must remain formally registered and mapped for transport to proceed.

transport_closure_conditions.name: transport_does_not_force_unique_reconstruction
transport_closure_conditions.description: Nonlocal propagation does not bypass preimage ambiguity or non-invertibility.

transport_closure_conditions.name: noninvertible_transport_preserved
transport_closure_conditions.description: The path-dependent nature of NavT is maintained across the closure structure.

transport_closure_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_transport_witness
transport_closure_conditions.description: Pruning of nonlocal branches must not eliminate all possible transport paths.

transport_closure_conditions.name: residue_accumulation_does_not_force_transport_divergence
transport_closure_conditions.description: Accumulated residue must not trigger runaway transport flux or basin escape.
